……生徒会の依頼って、たまに変なやつがあるんだよな。: ...The Student Council really does send us some weird requests sometimes.
今日頼まれたのは、生徒会の使っている倉庫のうち、\nかなり年季の入ったやつの内部:
Today's job was to give one of the Student Council's older storerooms
a quick clean and tidy-up.
棚などは物の出し入れを久しくしていなかったらしく、\nかなり汚れていたのでほこり:
It looked like nobody had touched the shelves in ages.
They were filthy, so I dusted them off and cleared out a few shelves and lockers.
微々たるものだが何かしらには役立ったらしい。お礼にと、\n古ぼけた白衣や看護服を:
It wasn't much, but apparently it helped. As a thank-you,
they gave me an old lab coat and a nurse's uniform... What am I supposed to do with these...?
不思議と懐かしさが過り、もらってきた白衣に袖を通してみた。: For some reason, it felt nostalgic, so I slipped on the lab coat I'd brought back.
よう、彩峰。そっちも仕事あがりか？: Hey, Ayamine. You finished working too?
オレの顔を見るなり、踵を返して脱兎の如く駆け出した。: The moment she saw my face, she turned on her heel and bolted.
って待て！？ オレ、なんかしたか！？: Hey, wait! Did I do something?!
だったら何ですぐ消えようとしてんだよ！？: Then why are you running away?!
……わからない。白銀のせいじゃない。: ...I don't know. It's not your fault, Shirogane.
よし捕まえた！こう逃げられたんじゃ、心配しないわけにはいかねーよ！\n……んで、:
Got you! How am I supposed to not worry when you run away like that?!
...So what's wrong?
……どうもしてない。\nただ、白銀を見たら、急に胸がざわざわした。それだけ。:
...Nothing's wrong.
I saw you, Shirogane, and suddenly felt all unsettled. That's all.
今は…すごく落ち着いてる。不思議。: Now... I feel really calm. Weird.
何だそれ？たまたま疲れがドッと出たとかか？\nとりあえず大丈夫なんだな？:
What's that supposed to mean? Did all the exhaustion just hit you at once?
You're okay now, though?
うっせーよ！……っハァ、部屋まで送ってくよ。\n途中でまた倒れられても困るしな。:
Shut up! ...Hah. I'll walk you back to your room.
Can't have you collapsing again on the way.
彩峰はその後も変わりなく、ホッと胸を撫でおろすことができた。\n……この白衣や看:
Ayamine was fine after that, so I could finally breathe easy.
...Seriously, what am I going to do with this lab coat and nurse's uniform...?
くそーっ！追いつけん！\n白衣で走りにくいったらありゃしない！:
Damn it! I can't catch her!
This lab coat's impossible to run in!
きゃー。\n白衣を着た変質者が追いかけてくるー。:
Aaah.
A creep in a lab coat is chasing me.
人聞きの悪いこと言うなよ！？\nあっ、ちょっ、ま、待てこらーーー！:
Don't make it sound like that!
Ah, hey, w-wait! Get back here---!
風紀委員に通報しとくね。じゃ。: I'll let the Disciplinary Committee know. Bye.
――その後、通報を受けた風紀委員たちに取り押さえられかけたものの、\n事情を説明:
Later, the Disciplinary Committee nearly pinned me down after getting her report,
but I managed to explain things and get out of trouble.
白衣を着ていて、鞄に看護服が入っていたことについては、\n最後まで誤解を解くこと:
I never did clear up the misunderstanding about why I was wearing a lab coat
and carrying a nurse's uniform in my bag...
